eyebrow: A model card is a README with YAML metadata
caption: License, language, datasets, pipeline_tag — all structured and filterable.
model-index YAML becomes the rendered Evaluation results widget.

eyebrow: The paper is a five-second credibility check
caption: Every serious model links the paper it implements.

code:
pipeline_tag + tags  -> does it do the task
License              -> can you use it legally
Downloads / Spaces   -> is it trusted in practice
model-index evals    -> benchmark scores (self-reported)
Paper + citations     -> is the method real, traceable
Finetuned from        -> what it's actually built on
caption: No single row is sufficient alone — read all six.

subtitle: One real, small project — the whole course, put together.
